d: Nitish Setu in Bihar:bihar men ganga par ek aur mahasetu bankar taiyar hai... nam hai nitish setu... patna ke kachchi dargah se vaishali ke bidupur ko jorne vala ye chhah len ka pul uttar aur dakshin bihar ke bich kanektiviti ki naee ibarat likhne ja raha hai... 21 navanbar ko pradhanmantri narendr modi nitish setu ko rashtr ko samarpit karenge... lekin udghatan se thik pahle is pul ke namakran ne bihar ki siyasat men naee charcha chher di hai... samrat sarkar ne purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke nam par iska nam nitish setu rakha hai...vikas ke is pul ke jarie NDA ne piem modi aur nitish…
